item.title: Lord of the Rings: Rings of Power Season 3 Tries Too Hard to Copy Peter Jackson’s Trilogy
item.description: There are several scenes in Rings of Power season 3 that have direct parallels to key moments in Jackson’s films. The elves Galadriel (Morfydd Clark) and Arondir (Ismael Cruz Córdova) travel into enemy territory with an unreliable guide who doesn’t like elf food and pits the friends against each other, just like Gollum does with Frodo and Sam. Galadriel finds herself hiding in a hedge from a Nazgnagôl, the still-living precursors to the Ringwraiths that would put Frodo and his Hobbit friends in the exact same position. At one point, Galadriel evokes the power of “fellowship” as something that can provide hope against Sauron, and it feels almost as hamfisted as Elrond name-dropping the title of The Fellowship of the Ring in Rivendell.

item.title: The Settlers of Catan Movie Has Finally Found Its Directors
item.description: Netflix's upcoming adaptation of The Settlers of Catan is starting to take shape, with the popular board game officially one step closer to becoming a live-action movie. The streaming service has tapped a film-making duo to director the film — the first official move from the project since it was announced.

item.title: M. Night Shyamalan's The Visit: Now Free on YouTube
item.description: Though Halloween is over, that doesn't mean that horror movies need to be put on the shelf until next year. In fact, it could even be argued that November is a perfect time to continue watching them. Writer/director M. Night Shyamalan has no shortage of horror films that can work in the chilly, dreary days of November, such as 2004's The Village . But an underrated 2015 found-footage horror film manages to cement itself in Shyamalan's filmography as one of his greatest unexpected achievements.

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Gives Its Best Boy the Happy Ending He Deserved Decades Ago
item.description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a mostly faithful remake , true, but there's a generous handful of tweaks and expansions that fill out this version of Hyrule beautifully. Most of those changes are grim. This game is sad — if speaking to the Kokiri after clearing The Great Deku Tree dungeon didn't clue you in on that, just chat to people with the Mask of Truth on — and it wants you to be sad too. One of these changes flies in the face of misery and is defiantly happy, though, and it involves the game's bestest boy: Richard .

item.title: How to get the Biggoron Sword in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Biggoron's Sword is the strongest sword in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. However, it's also the most time-consuming weapon to get in the entire game.

item.title: HBO Max-Paramount Plus Bundle Officially Confirmed for 2027
item.description: HBO Max and Paramount Plus are officially joining forces, with a new streaming bundle set to launch in early 2027. Skydance Corporation, which completed its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery in October, confirmed the plans in its third-quarter shareholder letter on Monday.

item.title: The Best New Video Games of 2026 (So Far)
item.description: It's hard to believe, but 2026 is winding down. Well, maybe that's easy to believe if you remember that Code Vein 2 and Highguard kicked off the year in January, and both now feel like ancient history. We're getting closer to putting together our year-end game of the year come December, but there's still a long road until then. We're still catching up on a busy year of games, from big-budget hits to indie hidden gems. Oh, and there's still this little game called Grand Theft Auto 6 to consider.
